full_text_en:
First Branch of Chongqing Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Yan Xian — embezzlement case

[Ruling Summary]

Pursuant to the provisions of Article 382, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, where a state functionary, after being assigned to hold a position in a collectively owned enterprise, subsequently continues to hold the position upon election by the enterprise's职工代表大会 and approval by the competent superior administrative department of the enterprise, such person shall still be regarded as a state functionary. Where such a person, by taking advantage of his office, instructs others to falsify accounts, and through means such as transferring funds by bank transfer or withdrawing cash, misappropriates public funds, the conduct constitutes the crime of embezzlement.

Criminal Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2002) Xing Fu Zi No. 57

Defendant Yan Xian, male, born September 16, 1958, Han nationality, native of Chongqing, education: college diploma, former manager of Chongqing Spring Factory, residing at No. 41 Building, Annex 3, Wusi Road, Yuzhong District, Chongqing, arrested on April 17, 1998. Currently in custody.

The First Intermediate People's Court of Chongqing tried the case initiated by the First Branch of Chongqing Municipal People's Procuratorate charging the defendant Yan Xian with the crime of embezzlement. On February 26, 1999, it rendered Criminal Judgment (1998) Yu Yi Zhong Xing Chu Zi No. 498, finding the defendant Yan Xian guilty of embezzlement and sentencing him to death, deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property valued at RMB 200,000. After the judgment was pronounced, Yan Xian refused to accept it and appealed. The Chongqing High People's Court, on December 24, 1999, rendered Criminal Ruling (1999) Yu Gao Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 131, setting aside the first instance judgment and remanding the case for retrial on grounds of unclear facts and insufficient evidence. The First Intermediate People's Court of Chongqing, on March 15, 2001, rendered Criminal Judgment (2000) Yu Yi Zhong Xing Chu Zi No. 577, finding the defendant Yan Xian guilty of embezzlement and sentencing him to death, deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property valued at RMB 100,000; and guilty of the crime of misappropriation and sentencing him to 15 years' imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for 5 years, and forfeiture of property valued at RMB 50,000. The combined sentence was death, deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property valued at RMB 150,000. After the judgment was pronounced, Yan Xian refused to accept it and appealed. The Chongqing High People's Court, on December 28, 2001, rendered Criminal Ruling (2001) Yu Gao Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 445, dismissing the appeal and affirming the original judgment, and reported the case to this Court for approval in accordance with the law. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel and conducted a review of the case. The review is now concluded.

Upon review, the following facts were confirmed:

In December 1994, the defendant Yan Xian was dispatched by the Organization Department of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee from the Chongqing Local Taxation Bureau to Chongqing Spring Factory, a collectively owned enterprise under the former Chongqing Municipal Bureau of Mechanical Industry Administration, for a temporary assignment, serving as deputy manager. On January 18, 1996, Yan Xian was elected by the职工代表大会 of Chongqing Spring Factory and, upon approval by the former Chongqing Municipal Bureau of Mechanical Industry Administration, served as manager of the factory.

In December 1994, taking advantage of his position as deputy manager of Chongqing Spring Factory, the defendant Yan Xian, without authorization, opened a bank account in the name of the factory at Chongqing Chujin City Credit Cooperative, which he controlled personally. On December 29 of the same year, Yan Xian falsely claimed that it was an advance payment for the facade project of the Chongqing Municipal Bureau of Mechanical Industry Administration, obtained a transfer check for RMB 130,000 from the factory's cashier, deposited the funds into the said bank account, and took personal possession and use of the funds.

On December 30, 1994, the defendant Yan Xian instructed the factory's financial personnel to write off RMB 564,640 in a single entry under the pretext of an advance payment to Chongqing Xiyuan Construction Engineering Company, and to pay and offset the amount in installments. However, Yan Xian did not pay the said amount to Chongqing Xiyuan Construction Engineering Company. Instead, from January 3 to March 30, 1995, on six separate occasions, he obtained six transfer checks totaling RMB 564,640 from the factory's cashier, deposited the funds into the said bank account, and took personal possession and use of the funds.

In November 1995, the defendant Yan Xian, citing plans for the factory to jointly produce springs with China Jialing Industrial Co., Ltd. (Group), instructed the factory's financial personnel to write off RMB 1,179,397.46 in a single entry under the pretext of repaying advances made by China Jialing Industrial Co., Ltd. (Group). However, Yan Xian did not pay the said funds to China Jialing Industrial Co., Ltd. (Group). Instead, taking advantage of his positions as deputy manager and later manager of Chongqing Spring Factory, from December 19, 1995, to June 1996, on eight occasions, he obtained eight transfer checks and cash checks from the factory's cashier, and through transfers and cash withdrawals, appropriated RMB 579,397.46 of the funds for himself. From April to July 1996, through transfers and other means, he transferred RMB 300,000 of the funds out of the factory's accounts and, through others, withdrew cash, appropriating the funds for himself. In September of the same year, Yan Xian fled with the funds.

In summary, taking advantage of his office, the defendant Yan Xian misappropriated a total of RMB 1,574,037.46 in public funds belonging to Chongqing Spring Factory. After the case was discovered, the procuratorial authorities recovered stolen money and items purchased with the stolen money totaling RMB 89,851.9.

The above facts are confirmed by documentary evidence such as accounting vouchers, transfer checks, cash checks, deposit slips, accounting appraisals, witness testimony, and the recovered stolen money and items purchased with the stolen money, and are also confessed to by the defendant Yan Xian, and are sufficient to establish.

This Court holds that the defendant Yan Xian, being dispatched by the Organization Department of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee to serve as deputy manager of Chongqing Spring Factory on a temporary assignment, and having been elected by the职工代表大会 of Chongqing Spring Factory and approved by the state organ, the former Chongqing Municipal Bureau of Mechanical Industry Administration, to serve as manager of the factory, was in both cases engaged in public service as dispatched by a state organ, and shall be regarded as a state functionary. During his tenure as deputy manager and manager of Chongqing Spring Factory, taking advantage of his office, he instructed the factory's financial personnel to falsify accounts, and through means such as transferring funds by bank transfer and withdrawing cash, misappropriated public funds totaling over RMB 1.574 million. This conduct constitutes the crime of embezzlement. The amount embezzled is extremely large, and he fled with the funds, with over RMB 1.4 million in stolen money still unrecovered. The circumstances are particularly serious, and based on the crime, he should be sentenced to death. However, given that during the second instance trial, he reported the hiding place of other criminal suspects and assisted the public security authorities in apprehending them, constituting a meritorious act, the sentence of death may be imposed with a two-year reprieve. The facts found in the first instance judgment and the second instance ruling are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the trial procedures were lawful. However, the first instance judgment and the second instance ruling improperly characterized Yan Xian's position as manager of Chongqing Spring Factory as that of a person in a collectively owned enterprise, and consequently characterized his misappropriation of public funds during his tenure as manager as the crime of misappropriation rather than the crime of embezzlement. This error shall be corrected. In accordance with Article 199 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Item (3) of Article 285 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 12, Paragraph 1, Article 382, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of Article 383, Article 93, Paragraph 2, Article 48, Paragraph 1, Article 57, Paragraph 1, Article 59, and Article 68 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Set aside Criminal Ruling (2001) Yu Gao Fa Xing Zhong Zi No. 445 of the Chongqing High People's Court and Criminal Judgment (2000) Yu Yi Zhong Xing Chu Zi No. 577 of the First Intermediate People's Court of Chongqing;

2. The defendant Yan Xian is guilty of the crime of embezzlement and is sentenced to death, with a two-year reprieve, deprivation of political rights for life, and forfeiture of property valued at RMB 150,000; the interest income from the defendant Yan Xian's illegal gains in the amount of RMB 16,220.86 is to be confiscated; and the remaining stolen money not yet returned, in the amount of RMB 1,484,185.56, shall continue to be recovered.

This judgment shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Gao Guijun
Judge: Ye Xiaoying
Judge: Yao Yuzhi

November 21, 2002

Clerk: Han Jinping

[Introduction to the Presiding Judge]

Gao Guijun, Senior Judge: Born in 1955, Master of Laws. Served as Deputy Chief Judge of the Adjudication Supervision Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court from 2002.
